svg.text: PG-1 COMPLETE WIRING: every part, every lug, every wire

Each wire has its own lane. At each end it says in words where its OTHER end goes. Black = ground. Grey lugs = leave empty. wiring-3d.pdf shows the same wires inside the box; WIRE-LIST.md is the tick list.
Not drawn (on the carrier board already): the in / out jacks, the leveller's 2 light pairs OC1 / OC2 (BUILD-GUIDE 6c). fx loop header (2 x 4): leave it EMPTY.

Seed3 socket places 16-21 are not used (16 = the key: snip the Seed3's pin 16, block place 16). Grey lugs: leave empty. Wires marked 'join' are bare offcuts between neighbouring lugs (see WIRE-LIST.md).
The jack's + is its SLEEVE lug (centre-negative). Find the pot's pin 1 / 3 and the switches' lugs with the multimeter (BUILD-GUIDE 5, 6b, 6b2) before soldering.
